added_lines: padre pio devotions: first tuesday of the month in ballyduff. 7:30pm eucharistic adoration: thurs in causeway / wed in ballyduff. 10:30am divine mercy devotion: every sunday in ballyduff church 3pm devotions: first saturday of the month in causeway church holy hour: first sunday of the month in causeway church 3:00pm private confessions: first sat ballyduff 11-11:45 / causeway 12-12:45 deaths: mary quilter, kathleen barrett thought for the week: love god, love your neighbour. we don’t love in order to get to heaven; we love because heaven is already ours in christ. we don’t love in order to win god’s favour; we love because we already have god’s favour in christ. we don’t love so that god will love us; we love because god has loved us in christ with the greatest love we will ever know, the crucified love of jesus. jesus came to make us more loving. what form this loving takes is not important, but what is important is that it does take place. rosaries october: holy well, lady’s walk 3pm mon-fri, feans grotto 8pm welcome to god’s family: baby alison julieanne o’carroll please note all those on november lists will be remembered at all masses during november causeway branch agm: monday 26th oct 8pm in monty’s rooms. new members welcome. ccag: 50/50 draw: jack & matilda boulton sacrament of reconciliation: wed 28th october 7pm ballyduff church mass change: next weekend for the month of november seanfhocail : folaíonn grá gráin. love is blind. annual november mass university hospital kerry : for all those who have died within the hospital over the past year, including those who have died in palliative care services, maternity services, the relatives of hospital staff, and former staff members of. the mass for the dead will be celeb rated on monday 2nd nov 7pm in st john’s church, castle street, tralee. causeway / ballyduff

1ú 10.00am 1. tim devane, glen minard. rota: min eoc: marie uí ghrifín. léitheoir: risteard maceoin. thought for the day: jesus does not pluck his summary teaching from the air, he quotes from the shema yisrael, the great daily prayer of judaism found in deuteronomy 6. the second part about the love of neighbour is taken from leviticus 18. this mission statement stands as a resounding appeal to us today. we are asked not just to believe that there is a god, but to love god. we are asked not just to respect our neighbour, but to love our neighbour. love is not only the truth about human beings but also the truth about god, who is love itself. prayer: great and loving god, your love for us is beyond what we can grasp with our minds and hearts. let such great love for all awaken in us a true love of you and lead to authentic service of our neighbour.
